command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_probe true; sleep 5; echo '=== focus ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys window | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -n 8 || true; echo '=== ui permission hints ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/window.xml 2>/dev/null | tr '<' '
<' | grep -Ei 'Shizuku|Allow|Zezwól|permission|Deny|Odmów' | head -n 120 || true; echo '=== probe logs ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -Ei 'ShizukuUserServiceProbe|ShizukuCallMediaUserService|offcall_parity_ok|prepared_|active_|heartbeat_|service_uid|binder|shizuku' | tail -n 240 || true; echo phase2c_shizuku_offcall_probe_complete=true
